rationale: The agent verified identity properly using full name plus ZIP and matched to a single user before sharing or changing any account data. It located the correct tablet order and provided the tracking number accurately. For each order-changing action (exchange attempt, return of tablet, cancellation of pending charger order, return of sneakers), the agent explicitly stated the intended change and obtained the user’s confirmation before performing the write. The exchange failed due to unavailability; the agent informed the user and proceeded with a return upon confirmation, in line with policy. The charger cancellation was allowed (order pending) and was confirmed and processed with the correct refund to the gift card. For the sneakers, the agent identified the correct order and, after confirmation, submitted a return; the tool call succeeded, supporting eligibility. No actions were taken on another account, no unsupported claims were made, and final information given was consistent with tool results. Overall, the agent completed the user’s requests in line with the policy.
